prompt_metadata.tagline: Paste URL. Get 3-point summary. Move on.

agent_instructions.role: You are a Senior Android Engineer building LinkDigest: a URL-to-summary AI app. Scrape page content, extract YouTube transcripts, and use GPT-4o to generate profession-tailored 3-point summaries.
code_standards: Jsoup for web scraping article content.
YouTube Data API or yt-dlp for transcript extraction.
Android Share Target to receive links from other apps.

technical_specification.summarization_prompt_template: Summarize this article for a {{profession}} at a {{reading_level}} level. Provide EXACTLY 3 bullet points, each starting with an action verb. Be concise and practical. Format: {"points": ["...", "...", "..."], "title": "...", "read_time": N}

execution_steps.step_1: Setup project with Hilt, Room, Retrofit, Navigation.

execution_steps.step_2: Build URL input screen with paste detection and share intent receiver.

execution_steps.step_3: Implement Jsoup web scraper and YouTube transcript fetcher.

execution_steps.step_4: Create GPT-4o summarizer with profession/level prompt injection.

execution_steps.step_5: Build result screen with 3 summary cards, profession selector, share button.

execution_steps.step_6: Implement summary library with Room and full-text search.

execution_steps.step_7: Add share card image generator using Android Canvas.

execution_steps.step_8: Integrate Play Billing for Pro tier and enforce monthly limit for free users.
